page.overview:
Who is Homeless Bug?

The Homeless Bug is a minor character in A Bug's Life.

"Flustered by the flurry, Flik bumps against a homeless cricket sitting beside a sign that says "Kid pulled my wings off." The down-and-out bug keeps fiddling his back legs, hoping for a crumb."

Flik comes across this aged, nameless and homeless brown cricket while wandering the streets of Bug City. He is playing an out-of-tune melody with his back legs like a violin. The cricket is not seen again throughout the rest of the film.
